stages.d: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pretreatment, then RO. Electrodeionization (EDI) only where your grade needs it. Duplicate RO trains are often specified.
Sized to the peak draw, such as washers filling together, so generation runs steady.
Pumps: [duty and standby pumps, standard or option]. 254 nm ultraviolet (UV) on the supply lowers the viable count; it does not sanitize the loop.

Natural PP is rated 0 to 80 °C, and its pressure rating falls as it heats. Routine 80 °C at loop pressure, a hot-held loop or steam needs a polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) or stainless loop [whether we quote PVDF].
Washers, sinks and bench taps on short branches; sections isolate for work. Endotoxin filtration: [endotoxin filter on the loop, standard or option].
Conductivity online after the last treatment step; samples at loop out, loop return and each outlet.
[PP loop sanitization method]; residual tested before use. PVC stays upstream, out of the critical-water loop.
